ledger: 00:00-00:07 Established room layout: The man stands in front of a wooden door with two vertical recessed panels and a round brass ornament at the top center. A solid dark-blue coat hangs on a hook on the door's left panel.

00:00-00:07 Established right-side layout: To the right of the center door's right panel is a vertical strip of green wall with a wooden switch box, followed on the far right by another wood-paneled section holding a framed picture.
00:00-00:07 Established left-side layout: To the left of the center door is a perpendicular wall with another wooden door seen at a steep angle along the left edge of the frame.

00:07-00:09 Traversal and camera pan: The man turns to screen left and steps toward the left-hand door to knock on it as the camera pans left, revealing the area that was previously behind him and to his left.

findings.entity: Center door and surrounding wall layout
findings.description: As the man steps left to knock on the adjacent door and the camera pans left, the established layout of the door and wall behind him warps impossibly: the right vertical panel of the center door, its top-center round brass ornament, and the adjacent green wall strip with the wooden switch box all vanish. Instead, a wood-paneled section with a framed picture appears immediately to the right of the hanging blue coat (which also gains a white stripe), in the exact space occupied seconds earlier by the right half of the wooden door.
